label: SspABCD-SspFGH system
definition: A phosphorothioate defense system in which an organism possesses an SspABCD-SspFGH locus that pairs an SspABCD-family single-stranded DNA phosphorothioation module with an SspFGH restriction module to damage non-phosphorothioated phage DNA and suppress phage DNA replication.
observations: SspABCD-SspFGH branch under phosphorothioate defense system; distinct from individual ssp genes, the SspABCD modification module by itself, the SspFGH restriction module by itself, SspABCD-SspE systems, Dnd systems, archaeal phosphorothioate antiviral systems, source database rows naming one predicted PT locus, phosphorothioate modification as a chemical trait, and the broader phosphorothioate defense parent.
